import os,json,System,clr
clr.AddReference('Grasshopper')
import Grasshopper as GH
root='C:\\Users\\08432.SINOLTD\\00.DEVE\\31.AEC\\RHINO_Deve\\EnvironmentalSimulationHub'
folder='C:/Program Files/ladybug_tools/grasshopper/ladybug_grasshopper/user_objects'
files=sorted(name for name in os.listdir(folder) if name.lower().endswith('.ghuser'))
components=[]
for name in files:
 path=os.path.join(folder,name)
 try:
  user=GH.Kernel.GH_UserObject(path)
  obj=user.InstantiateObject()
  def params(collection):
   return [{'name':str(p.Name),'description':str(p.Description),'optional':p.Optional,'type':str(p.GetType().Name)} for p in collection]
  components.append({'file':name,'name':name[:-7],'nickname':str(obj.NickName),'category':str(obj.Category),'subcategory':str(obj.SubCategory) if hasattr(obj,'Params') else '4 :: Extra','guid':str(user.Guid),'base_guid':str(obj.ComponentGuid),'description':str(obj.Description),'version':str(getattr(obj,'Message','Preset value list')),'inputs':params(obj.Params.Input) if hasattr(obj,'Params') else [],'outputs':params(obj.Params.Output) if hasattr(obj,'Params') else [{'name':'Selection','description':'Preset value list','optional':False,'type':'ValueList'}], 'preset_items':[{'name':str(i.Name),'expression':str(i.Expression)} for i in obj.ListItems] if hasattr(obj,'ListItems') else [],'availability':'INSTANTIATED','source':path})
 except Exception as e:components.append({'file':name,'availability':'FAILED','error':str(e),'source':path})
report={'scope':'Every installed Ladybug user-object file; no components solved during inventory','directory':folder,'count':len(files),'components':components}
json.dump(report,open(os.path.join(root,'docs','evidence','ladybug_full_inventory.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'instantiated':sum(c['availability']=='INSTANTIATED' for c in components),'failed':sum(c['availability']=='FAILED' for c in components)}))
